# Velmora Manager — Three-World Badge Pack

This pack contains 216 individual 512×512 transparent PNG club badges plus 12 six-by-three league sheets.

- Worlds: Kharova, Caldria and Ezuraya
- Four tiers per world
- 18 clubs per tier
- Sheet order is left-to-right, top-to-bottom
- `badge-manifest.csv` maps every badge to its club, nation, tier, row and column

The numbered individual filenames follow each tier's official club order.
